input: Use Mountain Xpress (mountainx.com) summer camp and kids guides (2024-2026) to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs summer camps 2026

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: Adventure and Kolo Bike Park summer day camps; listed in the 2025 guide.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Youth and teen summer camps, including outdoor programs; featured in the 2025 guide.

candidates.name: Asheville Sun Soo Martial Arts
candidates.note: Grades K–5 day camps with martial arts and themed activities; featured in the 2026 guide.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Overnight outdoor and leadership camps; featured in the 2024 guide, with summer 2026 confirmed.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: Weeklong nature-connection and specialty day camps at multiple locations; listed in the 2025–2026 issues. Only these five guide providers could be verified from accessible text.
